_comment: dns_watch configuration. Place at ~/.config/lanlookout/config.json (or set DNS_WATCH_CONFIG). Nextcloud credentials do NOT belong here; see nextcloud-config.example.json.

activeban._comment: Optional bridge to activeban. Only dangerous signals (report_kinds) and the canary probe are reported; NEW_PAIR / NEW_CLIENT are discovery signals and are never reported. ssh_host is the activeban host's forced-command account.

intel._comment: Optional threat-intel matching (INTEL findings). Use high-precision malware/C2/phishing domain feeds only - a hit is reported to activeban as trigger 'intel' when INTEL is in report_kinds. The list file (one domain per line) is refreshed daily by intel_fetch.py from intel_sources.
intel.name: urlhaus+openphish
